zh: 移动端（iOS & Android）新增语音通话收音波形光环动效，并统一音频会话与播放器生命周期管理，切换扬声器/听筒及中断播报更稳定。
修复移动端 Markdown 表格分隔行、转义竖线与列宽对齐渲染，补充代码块围栏、六级标题与有序/无序列表解析并新增共享单元测试。
优化桌面端对话右侧快速预览导航条在拖拽侧栏时的实时跟随与稳定性。
en: Add a live microphone waveform halo to mobile voice calls and unify iOS/Android audio session and MediaPlayer lifecycle handling across route switches and interruptions.
Fix mobile Markdown table parsing, escaped pipes, column sizing, fenced code blocks, level-6 headings, and list variants with shared unit test coverage.
Polish desktop quick-navigation rail tracking and automated test verification.
